2026 KENDRICK BAY TERMINAL HARVEST AREA FISHERY ANNOUNCEMENT

The following information details the Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association (SSRAA) Kendrick Bay Terminal Harvest Area (THA) commercial fishing schedule for the 2026 season.

SSRAA is forecasting a total run of 809,000 chum salmon for the Kendrick Bay THA with an anticipated terminal run of 405,000 chum salmon.

The Kendrick Bay Terminal Harvest Area (THA) will NOT OPEN. The Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association (SSRAA) will be conducting cost recovery operations in the Kendrick Bay THA beginning June 15, 2026, with the goal of taking approximately 1.5 million pounds of chum salmon designated for cost recovery. If this goal is reached, a separate advisory announcement will be issued opening the THA for common property purse seine and troll harvest. This could occur in early July.

The Emergency Order corresponding with this announcement is EO 1E1126.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
